annotations.title: Price a short stay for dates

description: Check whether a short-stay holiday let (stay_id from search_stays) is available for check_in / check_out (YYYY-MM-DD) and price it: nights, nightly rate, subtotal, cleaning fee and total, plus a bookUrl with the dates filled in. Booking takes payment and an account, so it finishes at bookUrl — never collect card details.
